subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Do the named workflow-security approvers authorize these exact 14 third-party GitHub Action revisions, including the actions used with app private keys, registry credentials, and OpenAI API keys?
rationale: The branch only changes external action code references, and no mechanical repository change can establish trust in those new upstream revisions for credential-bearing workflows.

options.title: Approve reviewed revisions
options.body: A named security approver verifies the pinned upstream commits and allows the refreshed dependency update to proceed.

options.title: Narrow the update
options.body: Split or defer the credential-bearing action revisions while accepting only the independently reviewed low-risk workflow action updates.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Close or defer the Dependabot batch if the aggregate action trust review is not worth the release and automation exposure.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed revisions
recommendation.body: A named security approver verifies the pinned upstream commits and allows the refreshed dependency update to proceed.

likelyOwner.reason: The dependency guard explicitly lists steipete as a security approver, and the PR timeline shows direct involvement.
